task: Interactive shipping/quality-control scene proof, not full factory replacement

verified_features: RealityKit lightmap support and Reality Composer Pro 3 light baker
soft spotlight shadows with lightSize and quality
Gaussian splat rendering shown on Apple Vision Pro
research.interpretation: Feature announcement does not prove every feature is available on iPhone. No claim of iOS Gaussian splat support or real-time path tracing is made.

verified_features: PBR with environmental lighting and HDR
research.interpretation: Asset quality, scale, lighting and exposure are more immediate bottlenecks than switching engines.

implementation_decision: Keep live SceneKit camera, selection and logistics animation; engineer tests precomputed Cycles irradiance day/night plus PBR surface response. Do not substitute a flat generated background for the interactive scene.
review_failures_found: iOS crash on grayscale roughness texture: converted to RGB by engineer
shipyard crane visually dominates the sanitary-ware control area
initial night glass has low text contrast
initial truck status claimed departure without actual motion
followup: Graphics pass and new iOS visual validation required before acceptance; record shipped features in release receipt, not this research note.
